The 2026 Israeli legislative election will be held using closed list proportional representation. Each party was required to present a list of candidates to the Central Elections Committee by 8 September 2026.[1]

Joint List

[edit]

The Joint List list is headed by Yousef Jabareen[9] and was submitted on 8 September.[10] Jafar Farah, a Hadash member who was placed fourth on the list, withdrew from the race following sexual harassment claims.[11] He was replaced by Faten Ghattas.[12] Sami Abu Shehadeh, initially third on the party's electoral list, withdrew after Supreme Court President Yitzhak Amit informed him the supreme court was likely to uphold his disqualification by the Central Elections Committee.[13]
